title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・あげてけ！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the support of her friends, Tosen Jordan makes a spectacular first place finish in the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cheers and applause thunder throughout the course, with no signs of dying down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan smiles at me and says, "Am I the greatest dummy ever or what?"
